Fully funded scholarships for Indian students can make an overseas degree possible without putting the full cost of tuition and living expenses on your family.

For 2027 entry, timing matters. Several major scholarships are already open, some will open later in 2026, and a few 2027 application windows have already closed.

So before spending weeks on an essay, check three things: are you eligible, what exactly does the scholarship pay, and is the application still open?

What Does a Fully Funded Scholarship Actually Cover?

"Fully funded" sounds simple. In practice, the benefits vary.

A strong full-cost scholarship may cover:

  • full tuition fees
  • a monthly living allowance
  • accommodation or residence costs
  • return flights
  • health insurance
  • books or academic materials
  • research or study allowances

Imagine two students receiving scholarships for the same £25,000 master's degree. The first gets tuition paid but must find another £15,000 or more for rent, food and travel. The second gets tuition, monthly living support and flights.

Both received major scholarships. Only one is close to having the whole cost covered.

Fully Funded Undergraduate Scholarships for Indian Students After 12th

There are simply fewer full-cost undergraduate awards.

But there are genuine options.

1. Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship

For September 2027 entry, the award covers:

  • tuition
  • books
  • incidental fees
  • full residence support
  • four years of undergraduate study

Around 37 students are selected each year.

According to the University of Toronto's current Pearson Scholarship information, the key dates for 2027 entry are:

  • 9 October 2026: school nomination deadline
  • 16 October 2026: University of Toronto admission deadline for Pearson consideration
  • 6 November 2026: scholarship application deadline

The scholarship covers tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years.

There is one catch students sometimes discover too late.

Your school must nominate you.

You cannot simply submit an independent Pearson scholarship application without that nomination.

2. MEXT Undergraduate Scholarship

Japan's MEXT Scholarship is particularly important for students looking for fully funded scholarships for Indian students after 12th.

The 2027 MEXT undergraduate guidance for applicants from India provides the current eligibility criteria, available fields and application information.

  • economics
  • business administration
  • law
  • engineering
  • architecture
  • pharmacy
  • nursing
  • biotechnology
  • medicine and other sciences

For the 2027 undergraduate programme, MEXT provides:

  • exemption from education fees
  • ¥117,000 per month
  • round-trip airfare
  • preparatory Japanese-language study where applicable

The official Japanese mission in India lists the ¥117,000 monthly allowance, education-fee exemption and round-trip airfare for the 2027 undergraduate scholarship.

The Indian application period ran from 23 April to 25 May 2026, so the 2027 undergraduate cycle is already closed.

This is a good example of why students should begin scholarship research before Class 12 results arrive.

3. Global Korea Scholarship

The Global Korea Scholarship, usually known as GKS, is a major Korean government scholarship covering both undergraduate and graduate study.

The current GKS programme information on the Korean government's Study in Korea portal lists support for:

  • airfare
  • Korean-language training
  • tuition
  • study allowances

GKS offers undergraduate routes as well as master's and doctoral opportunities.

For undergraduate applicants, the general framework includes non-Korean citizenship for the applicant and both parents, the required previous academic qualification, and academic performance equivalent to at least 80% in the most recent programme.

The usual undergraduate selection cycle begins with an announcement around September, followed by applications during September and October.

For Indian students targeting South Korea in 2027, this is therefore a scholarship worth monitoring now rather than waiting until the end of the year.

4. Reach Oxford Scholarship

Reach Oxford is one of the rare undergraduate awards that can cover most of the major costs of an Oxford degree.

India is currently listed among the eligible nationalities.

  • course fees
  • a grant towards living costs
  • one return airfare per year

It normally lasts three or four years depending on the degree.

There are only around two to three awards per year, so competition is exceptionally high. Oxford states that details for 2027 entry will be published in January 2027.

You must first apply to Oxford and receive an offer before you can be considered for the scholarship.

Can Indian Students Get Fully Funded BBA or Engineering Scholarships?

Yes, although the scholarship may not have "BBA" or "BTech" in its title.

MEXT's 2027 undergraduate fields include Business Administration and a wide range of engineering disciplines.

GKS also supports study across broad academic fields, including science and engineering routes.

The better search strategy is therefore:

course eligibility first, scholarship title second.

Do not search only for "BBA scholarship" and assume programmes with broader names are irrelevant.

Fully Funded Scholarships for Indian Students for Master's Study

Master's applicants have a much wider range of major international awards.

This is also where leadership, work experience and career direction begin to matter much more.

1. Chevening Scholarship

Chevening supports eligible one-year master's degrees in the UK.

It is one of the most recognised fully funded scholarships for Indian students pursuing postgraduate study abroad.

  • tuition fees
  • monthly living support
  • travel to and from the UK
  • selected additional allowances

For the 2027/28 cycle, Chevening's current application timeline confirms that applications opened on 4 August 2026 and close at 11:00 UTC on 6 October 2026.

Chevening is not simply an academic-merit scholarship. Leadership, career direction and evidence of impact matter heavily.

2. Commonwealth Master's Scholarship

India is an eligible country for Commonwealth Master's Scholarships.

For 2027/28 study, the current Commonwealth Master's Scholarship guidance confirms that applications open on 8 September 2026 and close at 16:00 BST on 20 October 2026. The awards are for UK study beginning in September or October 2027.

  • approved tuition fees
  • return airfare
  • monthly living allowance
  • study-related travel support
  • additional allowances where applicable

Applicants normally need to meet the academic requirements and show that they would not otherwise be able to afford study in the UK.

Another important detail: applicants cannot simply rely on the CSC deadline. Nominating bodies may set their own earlier deadlines or additional requirements.

So check both.

3. Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters

Erasmus Mundus suits students who are comfortable studying across more than one European country.

These are integrated master's programmes delivered by international university partnerships.

The European Commission's Erasmus Mundus programme information currently sets the scholarship contribution for individuals at €1,400 per month for up to 24 months.

A typical Erasmus Mundus programme includes study periods in at least two countries.

There is no single deadline for every Erasmus Mundus master's degree.

Each programme runs its own admissions process, so shortlist the actual courses first and record their deadlines separately.

That small step prevents a common mistake: knowing the scholarship name but missing the programme application.

4. DAAD EPOS

Germany's DAAD EPOS programme supports selected development-related postgraduate courses.

It is aimed at graduates from developing and newly industrialised countries and normally expects at least two years of professional experience.

The official DAAD EPOS scholarship database currently lists support including:

  • €992 per month for graduates
  • €1,400 per month for doctoral candidates from February 2026
  • health, accident and personal liability insurance support
  • travel allowance
  • possible additional rent or family support in some cases

DAAD has already published its list of participating courses and application deadlines for 2027/28.

Do not look for one universal EPOS deadline. The deadline depends on the programme.

5. Knight-Hennessy Scholars

Knight-Hennessy supports eligible graduate study at Stanford University.

The 2027 cohort application is already open and closes on 6 October 2026 at 1 pm Pacific Time.

Selected scholars can receive up to three years of financial support while completing an eligible Stanford graduate programme.

Applicants for the 2027 cohort generally need to have earned, or expect to earn, their first bachelor's degree in 2020 or later, with a broader window for eligible military applicants.

One practical point matters.

You are applying to Knight-Hennessy and to an eligible Stanford graduate degree. Winning one process does not remove the other.

6. Gates Cambridge Scholarship

Gates Cambridge is one of the most important full-cost postgraduate scholarships for students from outside the UK.

It supports eligible full-time postgraduate study at the University of Cambridge and is open to applicants from countries outside the UK. Gates Cambridge describes its awards as highly competitive full-cost scholarships.

For 2027 entry, Cambridge postgraduate applications begin opening in September 2026.

This is an excellent scholarship to target if you have an exceptional academic profile and can show a strong reason for your proposed postgraduate study.

Fully Funded PhD and Research Scholarships for Indian Students

At doctoral level, named scholarships are only one route.

  • university studentships
  • research councils
  • supervisors
  • funded research projects
  • departmental scholarships

So a student searching for a fully funded PhD should investigate both scholarships and funded positions.

Rhodes Scholarship

The Rhodes Scholarship supports postgraduate study at Oxford.

There are five Rhodes Scholarships available for India.

For the India constituency, the 2027 cycle opened on 1 June 2026 and closed on 23 July 2026, so applications are now closed.

If Rhodes is a serious goal for a future year, preparation needs to begin well before the official application window.

The selection process is demanding, and academic strength alone is not enough.

Gates Cambridge for PhD Applicants

Gates Cambridge also supports eligible doctoral study at Cambridge.

For research degrees, that often means preparing your proposed research area and potential supervisor well in advance.

Fulbright-Nehru Doctoral Research Fellowship

USIEF has published its 2027/28 Fulbright-Nehru Doctoral Research Fellowship.

The application deadline was 1 July 2026, and successful fellows are expected to begin their US programme around August or September 2027.

This is a research fellowship rather than a route for beginning an entire US PhD from scratch, so read the programme purpose carefully before applying in a future cycle.

That distinction matters.

For master's study, the range becomes much wider.

Eligibility and Documents: What Should You Prepare?

There is no universal academic percentage that unlocks every scholarship.

A scholarship may prioritise grades. Another may care heavily about leadership, professional experience, financial need or research potential.

Common requirements include:

  • strong academic results
  • an eligible previous qualification
  • relevant professional experience where required
  • leadership or community-impact evidence
  • a clear career or research direction
  • references
  • English-language evidence where required
  • nationality or residency criteria

You may also need:

  • passport
  • transcripts and certificates
  • CV
  • personal statement or scholarship essays
  • two or three recommendation letters
  • admission application
  • employment evidence
  • research proposal
  • portfolio for selected subjects

Start with the documents that depend on other people.

References are a good example. Asking a professor for a detailed recommendation the night before the deadline is not an application strategy.

If you are preparing your written application, focus on turning your motivation into specific evidence rather than generic claims. It also helps to understand what makes an academic or professional recommendation genuinely useful.

How to Apply for Fully Funded Scholarships

Step 1: Decide Your Level First

Are you applying:

  • after Class 12
  • for a master's
  • for a PhD or research programme?

This immediately removes scholarships that cannot fund you.

Step 2: Shortlist 8 to 12 Realistic Options

For each scholarship, record:

  • destination
  • level
  • eligible courses
  • academic requirement
  • work experience
  • admission requirement
  • scholarship deadline

Do not collect 50 scholarship names you will never apply for.

Ten well-matched applications are more useful than a spreadsheet full of impossible ones.

Step 3: Check the Earliest Deadline

Scholarship deadline and university deadline are not always the same.

Pearson is a perfect example. The school nomination happens before the final scholarship application.

Commonwealth applicants may also face separate nominating-body deadlines.

Work backwards from whichever date comes first.

Step 4: Use Evidence in Your Essay

Avoid lines such as:

"I am passionate, hardworking and want to make a difference."

Thousands of applicants can write that.

Show what happened instead.

If you organised a programme for 80 students, say what you did, what problem existed and what changed.

Specific details make an application more credible because another person cannot simply copy them.

Step 5: Prepare for Interviews Early

Some major scholarships interview shortlisted applicants.

Prepare real examples covering:

  • leadership
  • problem solving
  • failure or resilience
  • career direction
  • impact
  • why this course
  • why this country
  • what you plan to do afterwards

You can practise common international study interview themes before an invitation arrives.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

The most damaging scholarship mistakes are usually simple.

Applying without checking eligibility is one. If a scholarship requires a specific amount of work experience, being close does not make you eligible.

Using the same essay everywhere is another. Chevening, Rhodes, Commonwealth and Knight-Hennessy are not selecting candidates using identical criteria.

It may not cover a single night of accommodation.

Finally, check the year.

Scholarship articles remain online long after deadlines change. Always confirm the application date on the official source before pressing submit.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which countries provide fully funded scholarships for Indian students?

Indian students can find major fully funded or high-value scholarships in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, Japan, South Korea and across Europe. Examples include Chevening, Commonwealth, Pearson, MEXT, GKS, Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, Knight-Hennessy and Gates Cambridge.

How can I get a 100 percent scholarship to study abroad?

Are there fully funded undergraduate scholarships for Indian students after 12th?

Yes. Important examples include the Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship, MEXT Undergraduate Scholarship, Global Korea Scholarship and Reach Oxford Scholarship. These awards are highly competitive and can have deadlines many months before the university intake.

Which fully funded scholarships are available for Indian students for master's study?

Major options include Chevening, Commonwealth Master's Scholarships, Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters, DAAD EPOS, Knight-Hennessy and Gates Cambridge. Eligibility and deadlines differ considerably, so applicants should shortlist by country, course and work-experience requirements.

Are there fully funded BBA scholarships for Indian students?

Yes, depending on the programme. MEXT's 2027 undergraduate route includes Business Administration among its eligible fields, while other broad undergraduate scholarships may support business degrees if the chosen programme meets their rules.

Which scholarships are suitable for engineering students?

MEXT and GKS include science and engineering routes at undergraduate level. At postgraduate level, Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, Knight-Hennessy, Gates Cambridge and university-funded research programmes may support engineering students, depending on the specific course.

Do fully funded scholarships cover dependants?

Do I need IELTS for every fully funded scholarship?

No. Scholarship rules and university English-language requirements are not always the same. A scholarship may not independently require IELTS while the university still requires evidence of English proficiency for admission.

Final Thoughts

Fully funded scholarships for Indian students can remove one of the biggest barriers to studying abroad, but successful applications start with accurate matching.

Find the scholarship that fits your study level.

Check what it actually pays.

Confirm that India is eligible.

Then look at the deadline.

That sounds obvious, but it eliminates a surprising number of wasted applications.

A student with excellent marks who applies to the wrong programme may get nowhere. A student with a strong but realistic profile, clear evidence and the right scholarship match has a much better starting point.

For 2027, some important application cycles are already open. Others will begin over the next few months.

Once you know your preferred destination and study level, you can compare scholarship opportunities by country and build a shortlist that is actually worth applying to.
